Dynamic Coalition on Blockchain Assurance and Standardization (DC-BAS)
Introduction
This Dynamic Coalition is committed to advancing standards and best practices that foster a secure and trustworthy internet ecosystem. As part of this mission, it contributes to the development of industry standards & frameworks such as the
Blockchain Maturity Model (BMM)
and its corresponding
family of standards
, which support the assurance and standardization of blockchain technologies.
In addition,
DC
-BAS promotes the adoption of high-trust solutions by showcasing those that have earned recognized industry certifications and ratings, establishing a benchmark for reliability and excellence. The solutions listed below have been independently reviewed against globally accepted criteria for trustworthiness and reliability.
·
BMM Assessment Results
The
DC
-BAS is hosted by the
Government Blockchain Association (GBA)
, a non-profit organization with members that work in
over 500 government offices around the world
. The GBA has
over 50 working groups
supporting the use of blockchain technology to solve public sector needs and challenges. Its mission is to “Help the public and private sector connect, communicate, and collaborate by using blockchain and emerging technologies to improve public services.”
For more information visit the
GBA Blockchain Assurance & Standardization
webpage.
Action Plan
Please visit the
DC-BAS Website
for the current action plan.
Mailing List
Join the Google Group to receive information about activities and ways to get involved, Subscribe to the mailing list at
https://groups.google.com/g/dc-blockchain_assurance_and_standardization
.
To become actively involved join the
DC
-BAS by completing the
DC-BAS-Registration Form
.
Stakeholders
This group includes hundreds of members and extends an open invitation to people affiliated with:
·
Legislative bodies
·
Government administration
·
Private sector startups, companies and enterprises
·
Schools, colleges & universities
·
Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)
Documents/Reports
Annual Report 2025
Please visit the
DC-BAS Resources Page
for all documents and reports published by this group.
Website
https://gbaglobal.org/igf-dc-bas

-BAS [at] GBAglobal.org
